description: This file implements a thermal monitoring class (CThermalMonitor) that interacts with system hardware via IARM bus calls to get and set core temperature thresholds, retrieve current temperature, and emit threshold change events.

classes.name: CThermalMonitor
classes.description: A class providing thermal monitoring functionalities, including retrieving and setting temperature thresholds and emitting threshold change events.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CThermalMonitor.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an event observer for system services.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an event observer for system services.

methods.name: getCoreTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves the current core temperature via IARM bus call.

methods.name: getCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Retrieves current temperature thresholds (high and critical).

methods.name: setCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets new temperature thresholds (high and critical).

methods.name: emitTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a temperature threshold change.
